activity.notes: Oxford identifies Pheidon as king of Argos and places his reign most probably around 680–660 BCE. The surviving tradition is diffuse, so both boundaries remain approximate; Argos is used instead of generic Greece.

sources.title: Pheidon - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Pheidon as king of Argos and gives the most probable reign dating as c.680–660 BCE.
